vb_textbox.text: My advice is stick with the brighter colors and purple over pink. Think of that as color group one. Choose group one on each round until you see that the return is lower than previous rounds. When this happen, the other group of colors return a higher yield. Sometimes it switches for for a few rounds, when this happens try group two if you see that the return is higher. When you see that the return for group two falls, switch back to group one. The best choice alternates and it's best to try a few rounds when you think it switched, don't commit to just one group the entire game.
